phash5_v4.description: 5-fold OOF; folds = near-duplicate groups (pHash) + StratifiedGroupKFold; validation = v4 corruption, no rotation; evaluated at 224 px. Scores are NOT comparable with scene5_v4rot.

scene5_v4rot.description: 5-fold OOF; folds = 237 scene groups (scene_folds, fixed file); validation = corrupt_v4 + uniform random rotation in [-180, 180]; evaluated at the resolution listed per result. Use this protocol for all new comparisons.

scene_fold0_v4rot.description: Single held-out fold 0 of scene5 only. Quick screening; never compare against 5-fold OOF numbers directly.

leaderboard_only.description: Score known only from the Kaggle public leaderboard (30% of test). No local validation number exists for this submission.
